qc = QuantumCircuit(3)

# Prepare the uniform superposition.
qc.h([0, 1, 2])

# Apply exactly two Grover iterations. Qiskit's basis-state convention
# labels |101> as q2 q1 q0, so flip q1 to target that state.

    qc.h(2)
    qc.mcx([0, 1], 2)
    qc.h(2)
    qc.x([0, 1, 2])
    qc.h([0, 1, 2])

    qc.rz(2 * gamma, j)
    qc.cx(i, j)
